ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there is an external large square, and four congruent circles are respectively located near the four corners; each circle is tangent to two sides of the outer square and tangent to the two adjacent circles. There is also a rhombus-shaped square whose vertices are at the midpoints of the four sides of the outer square, and a centered small square; the four vertices of the small square are located at the centers of the four circles. The gray shading includes the part inside the central small square after removing four quarter-circle sectors, as well as several small sector regions between the small square and the midpoint rhombus. Reasoning: Let the radius of each circle be r. Adjacent two circles are tangent, so the distance between adjacent centers is 2r; therefore the side length of the central small square is 2r. The side length of the external large square is obtained from two radii plus the middle tangency relation as 4r. According to the specified sector decomposition, the shaded area is: the area of the central small square minus the areas of four quarter-circle sectors, plus the areas of eight 45° small sectors. A_shaded = (2r)^2 - 4(πr^2/4) + 8(πr^2/8) = 4r^2 - πr^2 + πr^2 = 4r^2. The area of the outer square is (4r)^2 = 16r^2. So the ratio of the total shaded area to the area of the outer square is 4r^2 : 16r^2 = 1 : 4.

method.method_draft: Use a direct sector-area computation. First read the diagram as four congruent corner circles, a midpoint square drawn as a diamond, and a central square whose vertices are the four circle centres. Let each circle have radius r. From the tangencies, adjacent circle centres are 2r apart, so the central square has side 2r and the outer square has side 4r. From the shading in the image, decompose the shaded area into: the central square minus four quarter-circle sectors, plus the eight small shaded 45-degree sectors lying between the central square and the midpoint diamond. Thus A_shaded = (2r)^2 - 4(πr^2/4) + 8(πr^2/8) = 4r^2. The outer square area is (4r)^2 = 16r^2, giving ratio 4r^2:16r^2 = 1:4.

method.method_draft: Use a geometric cancellation/dissection argument. Describe the image first: inside the central square, the unshaded parts at its four corners are quarter-circles; outside the central square but inside the midpoint diamond, the shaded parts next to each circle are two 45-degree sectors at that circle centre. Mentally move the outer shaded sectors into those four unshaded quarter-circles; then the total shaded area is exactly the area of the central square.
